title: Product Owner
text: **What We Can Do For You** At Specsavers, we know that to reach your full potential you need to work somewhere that will bring out your best. We pride ourselves on offering a workplace with a supportive, driven, flexible and inclusive culture. Proud To Be Recognised As Australia's #1 Best Place To Work For 2026 Ranked 12th On Fortune's List Of The World's 25 Best Workplaces. Here's a Taste Of Just Some Of Our Perks * Quarterly bonus scheme * Two free pairs of glasses each year * On-site free parking * Birthday, Volunteer, Professional Development and Paid Parental Leave * Health \& Wellbeing programs * Fully funded social club -- provides a wide range of activities throughout the year So, if you like the sound of working for a company that's dedicated to improving the lives of both their people and customers - *we think you'd look good at Specsavers.* **About The Role** This role sits within the Technology team and acts as the regional expert for our global SaaS Audiology Practice Management System and hearing screener platforms. Working closely with business stakeholders, global product teams, vendors and technology partners, you'll help shape the future direction of these products and ensure our products evolve to meet clinical, operational and commercial needs across ANZ. You'll take ownership of the ANZ product backlog, ensuring product priorities align with business, clinical and operational objectives. Working closely with stakeholders, vendors and global product teams, you'll translate business needs into practical solutions, drive continuous improvement initiatives, and support the successful delivery of product enhancements, upgrades and releases. You'll help maximise the value of our audiology platforms while ensuring they continue to evolve in line with business strategy and customer needs. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Product Owner, Product Manager, Application Specialist or Product Consultant who loves translating business needs into technology solutions that deliver measurable value. **What We're Looking For** * Experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, Application Specialist, Product Consultant or similar. * Strong experience working with configurable SaaS products. * Expertise in product roadmaps, requirements gathering, backlog management and prioritisation. * Experience supporting software implementations, upgrades and business change initiatives. * Strong stakeholder engagement and influencing skills, including the ability to align business and technology teams and influence external suppliers. * Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities. * A collaborative approach and the ability to work across multiple teams and priorities. **About Us** Specsavers are rated the market leader for eye tests, the retailer of choice for contact lenses and one of the fastest growing hearing providers in Australia and New Zealand. We are on a continual mission to transform eye and hearing health by eliminating preventable vision loss and blindness, including Glaucoma and Diabetes, through improved prevention and early detection, as well as providing accessible and affordable hearing care. At Specsavers we believe a diverse, inclusive, and flexible culture enables our people to bring their whole selves to work and be proud of doing so. When it comes to flexibility, we understand that one size doesn't fit all. Our flexible working at Specsavers enables us to work in ways that support our lifestyle to help us balance our career with the other important things in life. Creating a great place to work for our people is pinnacle to us and along with our Behaviours is at the core of everything we do. We like to think it's a fun and positive place to work -- why not have a look for yourself https://join.specsavers.com/au/department/support-office/

title: Salesforce Product Owner
text: Introduction: **About Us** We are an award-winning, national $18B public offer industry fund focused on the education and community sectors. Working for NGS Super means being part of something bigger and working to make a difference to our members and their financial future. Our people are key to our success, and as we grow, we're committed to finding and retaining the right talent to join the journey. As well as a flexible and fun workplace, we offer competitive benefits including additional leave entitlements, personal \& professional development and health \& wellbeing programs. *Click on the video below to learn more!* **About The Role** As the Salesforce Product Owner, you'll own the Fund's member data domain and connect the Member, Data and broader Technology teams to deliver integrated Salesforce, data and analytics solutions. You'll work across the Fund to understand business processes, pain points and opportunities, translating these insights into a clear member data roadmap, prioritised backlog and practical technology solutions. You'll set the direction for member data requirements, solution design, process standardisation and data quality, while providing hands-on Salesforce expertise and coordinating more complex development with technical teams and external partners. A key focus will be improving how data and technology support the member lifecycle, enabling a trusted 360-degree view of our members and a better member experience. **What You'll Do** * Partner with the Member team, Customer Relationship Managers and other stakeholders to understand business processes, identify underlying challenges and define improvement opportunities. * Facilitate workshops and discovery activities, translating business needs into clear requirements, acceptance criteria and prioritised backlog items. * Own and maintain the roadmap and backlog for Salesforce and member data improvements, balancing strategic priorities with day-to-day business needs. * Translate complex business, system, data, reporting and integration requirements into practical, scalable and supportable solutions. * Provide hands-on Salesforce functional design, configuration and testing, and coordinate more complex development and integration activities with technical teams and external partners. * Support agile delivery, user acceptance testing, release readiness, implementation and post-implementation review. * Improve systems, integrations and data practices to enable a trusted 360-degree view of the member. * Ensure member data is appropriately captured and structured to support operational decision-making, reporting and analytics. * Improve data quality, consistency and governance through clear definitions, controls, ownership and monitoring. * Identify opportunities to standardise processes, automate workflows and improve how Salesforce and connected systems are used across the Fund. * Track prioritised initiatives through delivery and keep stakeholders informed of progress, decisions, risks and changes. **About You** You'll bring: * Experience in a Product Owner, Business Analyst, CRM, technology solutions or business partnering role, ideally supporting customer or member-facing functions. * The ability to work closely with stakeholders to understand business challenges, facilitate discovery workshops and translate business needs into clear and actionable requirements. * Strong Salesforce experience, including solution design, configuration and optimisation of customer or member-focused processes. * A solid understanding of customer data, data quality, governance, reporting and systems integration. * Experience developing and managing roadmaps, backlogs and priorities to balance business needs with longer-term strategic outcomes. * The ability to connect business processes, technology, data and analytics into practical end-to-end solutions. * Experience using AI and automation tools to improve efficiency, streamline processes and deliver better business outcomes. It will be a bonus if you have a tertiary qualification in information technology, information systems, data, business analysis, business or a related discipline, and experience with the following: * Salesforce Data Cloud, Agentforce or Einstein capabilities. * Customer data platforms, Customer 360 solutions, marketing platforms, contact centre technologies or integration services. * Power BI, SQL or other reporting and analytics tools. * Superannuation, financial services or wealth management sectors. * Product Owner, Scrum Master, Project Manager or other agile delivery responsibilities. We are a super fund with an exceptional work culture, providing a diverse offering in developing our people and you can be a part of it while earning an attractive remuneration package! Interested and suitably qualified candidates should submit a copy of their updated CV. Please note that to be eligible for this role, you are required to have permanent Australian working rights and residency. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a workplace that values diversity, equity and respect for all individuals. **NGS Staff Benefits** We encourage you to familiarise yourself with our fantastic NGS Staff Benefits page (link below) to understand our offering which includes Additional Leave Entitlements, Personal \& Professional Development and Health \& Wellbeing Benefits. NGS Staff Benefits link: **https://ngssuper.elmotalent.com.au/careers/careers/pages/staffbenefits**

title: Senior Product Manager, Melbourne
text: **About Draftable** Draftable is building the next generation of document drafting tools for lawyers. We're part of Affinda Group, a founder-led global AI company based in Melbourne, Australia. Since launching our first legal product in 2023, over 1,300 law firms and legal teams globally have adopted our product, including leading firms like Allens, Mallesons and DLA Piper. We're growing ARR at well over 100% year-on-year, with very high win rates against incumbents and negligible churn. Our flagship document comparison product already exceeds incumbent tools, and it's just the foundation for a broader product suite we're actively building (our second legal-focused product Draftable Clean launched in March 2026). Our ambition is to become the leading provider of document drafting solutions for lawyers, and the most loved software in a lawyer's toolkit. **What makes this role compelling** * **Own a new product end-to-end:** From discovery through build and launch to its first paying customers * **Real traction, real distribution:** Customers are actively switching to us, we're winning head-to-head evaluations globally, and retention is best in class -- your product launches with an established go-to-market engine behind it * **Reimagine how product management works:** This isn't about adopting a few AI tools -- you'll help rearchitect product processes so humans working alongside AI agents define what we build * **High trust, real autonomy: A**collaborative, customer-centric culture focused on solving real problems, with flexible hybrid working * **Grow with the company:**Significant career upside as the product organisation scales **Why now** Legal technology is going through a generational shift. Law firms are moving away from aging, bundled platforms in favour of modern, best-of-breed alternatives. Draftable is on the right side of that dynamic. At the same time, AI is fundamentally changing how product teams work: how requirements are written, how software is built, and how fast teams can ship. For a product manager who wants to own a product end-to-end -- and to shape not just what gets built but how product management itself works in an AI-native company -- this is a rare moment. Strong market tailwinds, a product customers love, a clear multi-product roadmap, and the chance to build new AI-enabled product processes from the ground up. **The role** We're looking for an experienced, customer-centric Senior Product Manager to own one of the new products on our legal roadmap end-to-end: discovery and definition, build, launch, and the early go-to-market work that sets a new product up for commercial success. We've learned that a new product succeeds or fails on the foundations laid before and at launch -- early customer relationships, positioning, and adoption. You'll be accountable for your product's commercial success -- its adoption, retention and revenue -- though not alone: our established Sales, Marketing and Customer Success teams give a new product distribution from day one. You'll operate with substantial autonomy as one of the most senior product people in the team, and help raise the bar for product craft as we grow. **You will** * Own discovery for a new product: speak with customers to understand their problems deeply, define and validate the product, write PRDs and build prototypes with AI. * Lay the go-to-market foundations for launch: recruit early customers and design partners, shape positioning, and own the launch -- working closely with our established Sales and Marketing teams. * Work with engineers day-to-day to define and deliver the roadmap, owning prioritisation and acceptance testing prior to release. * Drive post-launch growth: join customer feedback calls, analyse HubSpot pipelines, pre-sales support trends, product testing feedback and product analytics data on adoption \& retention to prioritise improvements and new bets. * Do the hands-on work too -- we're a lean team: translate customer feedback into tickets, write release notes, produce product marketing assets (demo videos, objection handling guides, etc.) and train Sales and Customer Success roles. * Co-design AI-native product processes -- structuring product definition so AI coding agents (not just human engineers) can build from it -- using Cursor, Claude Cowork, Miro, Lovable, and custom internal tools. **What you will bring** ++Essential++ * Minimum 7 years in product management * Experience in taking a new product from zero to launch and first customers -- you know what has to be true before launch for a product to land commercially * Experience in B2B SaaS, ideally with an understanding of the legal industry * Strong product judgment and taste -- able to discern good from bad ideas, designs, and trade-offs (ideally grounded in product design experience) -- with a track record working with engineers to deliver on roadmaps * Product marketing chops -- able to produce assets yourself (videos, presentations, one-pagers), ideally in support of outbound sales * Active use of AI tools in your product work (including agentic tools like Claude Code, Cursor or Codex), with a view on how AI changes product management * Comfort operating with high autonomy in a growth-stage start-up * A data-driven approach to problem-solving, balancing technical, commercial, and user considerations * Excellent communication, able to distil complexity into clarity for different stakeholders to reach alignment ++Nice to have++ * Experience in legal technology or selling to law firms and professional services organisations * Product design education or hands-on design experience * Experience in challenger brands taking market share from larger incumbents **Location \& travel** * Melbourne-based hybrid role with office in Cremorne (next to the CBD). * Flexible working arrangements with regular in-person collaboration, and periodic travel for customer meetings, conferences, and events **Compensation** * AUD $160,000 - $190,000 (inclusive of super), based on experience. **How** t**o apply** * CV and a cover letter in PDF format explaining your product experience and why this role excites you Our process is concise and typically includes: 1. Introductory call 2. Product interview 3. Short work assessment 4. Final interview with leadership We're committed to fostering an inclusive workplace and welcome applications from all qualified individuals. We do not respond to unsolicited contact from recruitment agencies.

title: Group Product Manager
text: We've been proudly serving Australian communities since 1914 and have grown to become a top 30-listed company on the ASX with a portfolio of iconic homegrown brands. At the heart of our continued success is over 115,000 team members working across the country, all contributing to bringing our customers smiles. You'll not only get to see your work make a difference, you'll be part of a team working together to help Australians eat and live better every day. ### **About the team** Our Finance team are a vital partner in every aspect of our business, providing commercial insights to drive our success and influence everything we do. With presence in every department, we analyse performance, and deliver actionable insights that shape our strategic decisions. ### **About the role** As Group Product Manager - Payments, you'll lead the strategy, roadmap and delivery of products spanning payment switching, settlement \& reconciliation, and payment terminal solutions. You'll lead three experienced Product Managers while bringing together customer needs, industry trends, commercial priorities and regulatory requirements to set clear direction. Working across Retail Payment Solutions, technology, delivery teams, customers and external partners, you'll turn that direction into meaningful outcomes at scale. You will also: * Own and evolve product strategies, roadmaps and prioritised backlogs across Core products. * Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders, customers, payment schemes, technology providers and vendors. * Understand customer needs and market trends to shape compelling product requirements and value propositions. * Partner with delivery and technology teams to progress initiatives through project and Agile environments. * Support budgeting, business cases, commercial decisions, vendor management and profit and loss considerations. * Lead, coach and develop Product Managers, creating clarity, accountability and a strong team culture. ### **About you and your skills** You're an experienced payments product leader who can connect strategy with delivery, bring people together and confidently influence senior stakeholders without relying on positional authority. You combine strong customer judgement and commercial thinking with a respectful leadership style, helping experienced team members do their best work while keeping everyone focused on shared outcomes. You will have: * Proven experience in a senior product management and delivery capacity, with Payments products across the end-to-end value chain. * Experience working across payments services, cards or the broader financial services industry. * Strong end-to-end product portfolio management experience, including building, managing and evolving products. * Demonstrated experience developing and owning product strategies, roadmaps and prioritised backlogs. * Strong influencing and stakeholder management skills across senior leaders, customers and external partners. * Proven customer engagement and product delivery capability within complex, cross-functional environments. * Commercial capability across budgeting, business cases, vendor management and product performance. * Strong understanding of the payments industry, key trends and emerging payment technologies. ### **What's in it for you?** * **Flexible working options:**We know that work is only one part of your life, so we actively encourage a positive work-life balance and provide hybrid working options to help you achieve it. * **Office perks:** Take advantage of our gym facility and fitness classes, free parking, BBQ area, mini-Coles supermarket, fooderie hub where you can sample new products before they hit the shelves, school holiday program and so much more when you come in. * **Discounts:**Eligible team members receive 5% discount all year round on your Supermarket and Liquor online and in-store purchases. We also offer additional periods of double discount (10%) at various times throughout the year. As well as hotdeals exclusive to team members that translate into additional savings. * **Reward through recognition:** Give and receive recognition, linked to our Coles values, through our digital recognition platform 'mythanks'. You can accumulate points to redeem in the online shop for exciting gifts and electronic gift cards from an extensive range of retailers. * **Opportunities for learning and development:** No matter where you start within our diverse business, you'll have experiences, exposure, and education to satisfy you. Discover and explore a variety of career development programs and job-specific training. * **Paid parental leave:** We understand how important your life outside work is and offer permanent team members paid parental leave to support you in balancing work and family. * **Investment in your future:**Our annual team member share plan offer allows eligible team members to make regular pre-tax salary sacrifice deductions to purchase Coles Group shares. ### **About the recruitment process** We're continuing to build a gender equitable team, and a culture that is just as diverse, inclusive and welcoming as the communities we serve. We are committed to creating a workplace that is safe and respectful for our team. We encourage applications from people of all ages, cultures (including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples), abilities, sexual orientation and gender identities. We're happy to adjust our recruitment process to support candidates with disability. For further information and additional contact details visit the 'Our Recruitment Process' section of our careers site or email \[email protected\] Job ID: 197775 Employment Type: Full time #LI-RM1

title: Lead Product Manager
text: **Location** - ----------- Melbourne; Adelaide; Brisbane; Hobart; Sydney **Employment Type** - ------------------ Full time **Location Type** - ---------------- Remote **Department** - ------------- Product **Who are we?** - -------------- At UpGuard, we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process 100 billion risk signals daily. This isn't just growth; it's a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk. We build the Cyber Risk Posture Management (CRPM) platform that security teams actually love. By integrating security ratings, threat intel, and agentic AI, we empower organisations to stay ahead of an ever evolving attack surface. We aren't just building another tool; we're defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale. **Where does this role fit in?** As **Lead Product Manager**, you'll own the strategy, the long-range plan and the investment case for a portfolio of product areas spanning multiple squads, and manage an autonomous and high-performing team of Senior Product Managers who are responsible for individual squad roadmaps. You'll also have the opportunity to stay 'on the tools', with responsibility for your own squad of engineers and designers. This is a new role for UpGuard, and represents our high velocity growth. We have always operated as a tight-knit team in a high-autonomy environment. Now we want to ensure that we have leadership in place ahead of our next milestone. A Senior Product Manager is accountable for the outcomes of one area. You are accountable for the portfolio and for the strength of the team. Your value is measured by their output as well as your own. **What will you do?** **Set strategic direction across multiple product areas** * Own product strategy and outcomes across a portfolio spanning multiple squads, accountable for customer, business and execution results. * Nurture the Senior Product Managers and in collaboration with our Product Operations team and other Lead Product Managers, maintain consistency in process across all squads. * Resolve the trade-offs and dependencies *between* squads that no single squad can tackle alone. * Build the product narrative for your squads, with oversight of revenue, engagement, retention and risk. * Partner with CPO/VP Product on strategic product decisions. **Responsible for long-term planning, investment and budget** * Own the vision for a rolling quarterly plan against a two-to-three year product vision, and keep both current as the market moves. * Empower Senior Product Managers as decision-makers for the investments in their product areas. * Prioritise across competing areas and ensure products within your remit are well balanced to succeed. * Continuously improve on how we discover, prioritise and deliver product across UpGuard **Lead and grow product managers and managers** * Manage, coach and develop product management staff across your areas, including Senior Product Managers and people managers. * Set a high bar for rigour, accountability and craft while investing in each person's growth. * Hire, onboard and level product managers as UpGuard scales. * Set the standard for how product management is practised here. **Drive commercial and customer outcomes** * Connect product strategy to retention, expansion, win rate and addressable market. * Work with Sales, Marketing, Support and Customer Success on positioning, packaging, pricing input, launches and enablement across the portfolio. * Represent UpGuard's product direction with customers, prospects and analysts. **What will you bring?** * 7-10 years of B2B SaaS product management experience, including 3+ years directly managing product teams. * A track record of owning strategy across more than one product area and turning it into measurable outcomes. * Experience defining, driving and advocating for complex product initiatives. * Excellent communication, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate with engineers and designers to create experiences that customers rave about. **What will give you an edge?** * Experience or qualifications in security, GRC or compliance. * Familiarity with cybersecurity concepts and solutions. * Experience building a high-performing product management function in a scaling company. * Experience with integrations, APIs, or data-driven product development. * A track record of identifying and seizing commercial opportunities within product strategies. **What's in it for you?** * **Monthly Lifestyle subsidy:** Use this for financial, physical, and mental well-being * **WFH set-up allowance:** To ensure you have the right environment to work in, we will help you get set up within your first 3 months at UpGuard * **$1500 USD annual Learning \& Development allowance:**To support your career development, all team members will be able to expense development opportunities against this allowance * **Annual leave:** PTO plus two additional UpGuardian leave days to give you time to recharge your batteries. * **18 weeks paid Parental Leave:**Irrespective of parenting role * **Personal Leave Allowance:**This includes sick \& carer's leave * **Fully remote working environment:**While we have physical offices in Sydney \& Hobart, we do not mandate compulsory attendance * **Top-spec hardware:**All team members will be provided with top-spec laptops for their role * **Generative AI subsidy:**UpGuard provides paid subscriptions for all team members to access generative AI tools to support their work. UpGuard is a Certified Great Place to Work® in the US, Australia, UK and India, establishing its position as a leading global technology employer. 99% of team members agree that UpGuard is a great place to work! Apply now to find out why! As an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. **Please Note:** Not all roles can be performed from the United States. Please check your specific job listing to confirm its advertised location. If the role you are applying for is listed as based in the US, we are currently only able to support hiring in the following locations: CA, CO, FL, IL, MA, MD, MO, OR, PA, TX, WA, and DC. Before starting work with us, you will need to undertake a national police history check and reference checks.

title: Data Product Manager
text: Data Product Manager Sydney (Surry Hills) · Hybrid · Full-time Advoc8 is a political monitoring and intelligence platform for government relations and policy professionals. Our customers rely on Advoc8 to understand what is happening across government and access accurate, timely information about the people, institutions and issues shaping public policy. This is not a traditional software Product Manager role. It sits at the intersection of data product management, information strategy and data operations. You'll own the political information that powers Advoc8: deciding which information is most valuable to our customers, and work out how Advoc8 can source and maintain it reliably at scale. You may come from product management, knowledge or information management, research operations, data analysis or a similar role. We're less concerned with your exact title than your ability to understand a complex information landscape, form a clear view on what matters and build scalable ways to maintain it. You'll need to be curious, commercially minded and opinionated. We want someone who can look at the universe of data available to us and develop a clear point of view on what matters and what we should prioritise. What you'll do - Develop a deep understanding of the political data landscape and identify valuable new datasets and sources. - Own and evolve Advoc8's Data Product Roadmap, setting clear priorities for coverage and investment. - Validate data priorities with customers, Product and customer-facing teams. - Monitor data health and ensure updates are reflected quickly in Advoc8. - Design reliable, repeatable ways to source, validate and maintain data. - Oversee research and data operations, including contractors, while remaining hands-on where needed. About you You're a strong researcher and systems thinker who can move comfortably between strategy and detail. You'll bring: - Strong research and analytical skills, with the ability to form and communicate a clear point of view. - Good product and commercial judgement about which data creates meaningful customer value. - A systems mindset and an instinct for making processes reliable, repeatable and scalable. - High standards for accuracy and attention to detail. - Confidence engaging with customers, technical teams and senior stakeholders. - The ability to take ownership, make recommendations and work through ambiguity. - An interest in politics, government data, automation and/or data sourcing. Experience with APIs, scraping, databases, automation tools or structured datasets would be useful, but you don't need to be a software engineer.

title: Senior Product Manager
text: **About Netwealth** Netwealth isn't just a company. We're shaping the future of wealth in Australia. Our award-winning platform and NextGen technology empower advisers and investors to achieve more, and we're proud to be recognised as one of Australia's most innovative FinTech businesses. Since 1999, we've grown rapidly by challenging the status quo. We move fast, think big, and stay agile. Free from unnecessary bureaucracy so we can deliver smarter solutions for our clients and create real impact. But what truly sets us apart? Our people. We're a team of curious, optimistic and courageous individuals who collaborate to make life better for more Australians. We value authenticity, and agility, and we believe in creating an environment where you can do your best work, grow your career, and feel part of something meaningful. If you're looking for a place where your ideas matter, where innovation is celebrated, and where you can help shape a brighter financial future, join us at Netwealth. **The Opportunity** At Netwealth, we're continuing to evolve one of Australia's leading managed investment platforms, helping advisers deliver better outcomes for their clients through innovative, scalable investment solutions. We're looking for an experienced **Senior Product Manager** to lead our **Managed Accounts and Managed Discretionary Accounts (MDA)** portfolio. This is a high impact leadership role responsible for shaping the future of a strategically important product area that sits at the intersection of investment products, platform technology, adviser experience and operational excellence. You'll lead a team of Product Managers and work across Product, Technology, Operations, Financial Products, Distribution, Risk and Compliance to deliver outcomes that create value for advisers, investors and the business. What you'll be doing - ------------------- * Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for Netwealth's Managed Accounts and MDA product portfolio * Lead the evolution of our managed accounts offering while driving the continued uplift of MDA capabilities * Partner with stakeholders across the business to identify opportunities, solve complex problems and deliver customer focused outcomes * Drive product discovery with advisers, model managers, MDA providers and internal teams to deeply understand market needs and validate solutions * Balance customer value, commercial outcomes, operational efficiency and regulatory obligations when setting priorities * Define and measure product success through meaningful outcomes and OKRs * Act as the product leader and subject matter expert for Managed Accounts and MDA capabilities across Netwealth * Mentor, develop and lead a high performing team of Product Managers and Associate Product Managers * Support go to market activities and ensure stakeholders have the tools, knowledge and readiness needed for successful product launches About you - -------- You'll be a senior product leader who combines strong strategic thinking with the ability to execute in complex, highly regulated environments. You'll bring: * Deep experience in product management within wealth management, platforms, investments or financial services * Strong knowledge of Managed Accounts, Managed Discretionary Accounts or related investment and platform products * A track record of defining product strategy and delivering customer led outcomes through cross functional teams * The ability to influence senior stakeholders and build alignment across competing priorities * Experience leading, coaching and developing product teams * Strong commercial acumen and an ability to make data informed decisions * Excellent communication skills and the ability to translate complex concepts into clear, actionable outcomes **Life At Netwealth** At Netwealth, we believe a fulfilling career is built on **growth, balance, and belonging**. title: Lead Product Manager - Applied AI
text: **Who is Quantium?** Quantium is a world leader in data science and artificial intelligence. Established in Australia in 2002, Quantium is a global team of more than 1,200 people across 14 locations with a unique blend of capabilities across product and consulting services to help businesses unlock value from data and analytics. Quantium partners with the world's largest corporations to forge a better, more intelligent world. Our Product team sits at the centre of how we turn data science capability into market-ready solutions. As we scale our AI product portfolio, we are investing in rigorous, evidence-based validation to ensure we are building things that are genuinely worth building. This role sits at the very front of that process -- shaping what gets on the roadmap before a single line of code is committed. **How will you make an impact?** * Operate at the front of the AI product funnel -- assessing incoming ideas and proofs of concept to determine whether they are worth building, using evidence and commercial rigour rather than gut feel * Build and present invest-or-stop recommendations to senior stakeholders, including market sizing, unit economics, and strategic fit analysis * Make credible build-or-kill calls based on evidence gathered during validation -- including the hard call to stop something that does not stack up * Work with engineering, legal, and operations at the right moments in the validation cycle -- pulling them in proactively rather than treating them as downstream functions * Help shape the validation framework itself -- there is no existing playbook, and this person will have a hand in building it * Where opportunities survive validation, contribute to shaping the product vision and route to market **The Superpowers You'll Be Bringing To The Team** * Demonstrated experience doing real discovery, validation, and assumption testing ahead of any committed build -- not just executing against an agreed roadmap * Personally built commercial cases -- market sizing, unit economics, invest-or-stop recommendations -- that reached senior stakeholders and were stress-tested in practice * Has actually recommended stopping a product or opportunity based on evidence, and can articulate the reasoning, the evidence, and what happened next * Comfortable engaging engineering, legal, and ops during validation -- knows the right questions to ask without needing to be a developer or a lawyer * Self-directed and comfortable creating structure where none exists -- the validation methodology is still being built, so the right person builds the plane while flying it * Experienced enough to operate without an intermediary and make credible recommendations to senior leaders * Exposure to AI or agentic solutions; cross-industry experience in opportunity assessment; experience helping shape a product vision from a validated opportunity through to market. Remember -- you might not tick all the boxes, but don't let that from stopping you applying. We're more interested in how you work, your ability to solve problems and think big. **What could your Quantium Experience look like?** Working at Quantium will allow you to challenge your imagination. You will get to solve complex problems using rigor, precision and by asking great questions -- but it also means you can think big, outside the box and push your problem-solving skills to the max. **By Joining The Quantium Team, You'll Get To** * Forge your path: So many of our team have moved around different teams or offices. You'll be in the driver's seat, and we empower you to make your career your own. * Find your kind: Embrace diversity and connect with your tribe (think foodies, dog lovers, readers, or runners). * Make an impact: Leave your mark. Your contributions resonate, regardless of your role or rank. But wait, there's more! **We've Got Some Pretty Sweet Perks** * Flexible work arrangements: Achieve work life balance at your own pace with hybrid and flexible work arrangements. * Continuous learning: Our vision is empowering analytics talent to thrive. The Analytics Community fosters the development of individuals, thought leadership and technical excellence at Quantium through building strong connections, fostering collaboration, and co-creation of best practice. * Remote working: Embrace the opportunity to work outside of your assigned home location for up to 30 days every year. Apply now and let's forge a better, more intelligent world together! *Quantium's recruitment process involves the collection and use of personal information, see our Candidate Data Collection Notice for more information. This provides information on how we collect, use \& store your personal information, including potential disclosure to our majority shareholder, Woolworths Group Limited.*

title: Product Manager
text: Nine is Australia's largest locally owned media company. We are home to premium, trusted news, sport and entertainment. Nine's assets span free-to-air television, free and paid streaming, publishing and digital audio, and digital outdoor and retail media. Our content reaches almost every Australian - meaning what we do has real impact. We bring people together, celebrate the big moments, and capture the everyday ones. As our iconic and emerging brands continue to evolve, we offer unique opportunities for you to bring fresh ideas, innovate, and make your mark on the future of Australian media. *Stan* is Australia's leading local subscription service and a core part of Nine. From award-winning *Stan Originals* and global blockbuster premieres to live major sport on *Stan Sport* , we deliver world-class entertainment to screens nationwide. Joining our innovative team puts you at the center of Australian streaming, where you can collaborate with creative leaders, drive technology forward, and build a high-impact career. **Job Description** As a Product Manager in Streaming, you will play a key part in ensuring we are able to promote our content in the most immersive and engaging way possible on our flagship streaming products Stan and 9Now. You will own the strategy and requirements determining how our Streaming's unified platform ecosystem serves consumers engaging with our content through AI automation, tooling, workflows, and emerging technology, ensuring content performance today while building toward AI-led discovery. Alongside your Product and Engineering colleagues, you will work closely with Content Operations and Programming teams to build and optimised features, tools and workflows within our Content Management, Video Management Systems and Workflow Tools that enable the curation of extraordinary experiences for our users. With the exciting advances in AI technology, you will redefine and create new workflows, and inhouse built tools that power the experiences of the future. **Key Responsibilities** * Develop, Own and Execute Strategy \& Roadmap: Partnering with your stakeholders, develop a product strategy and roadmap for your remit that aligns closely with Streaming goals and wider Nine objectives. * Identify and implement workflow efficiencies: Partner with programming and operations teams to analyse tools and workflows to identify opportunities to streamline and automate operational processes that enable our teams with flexibility to do more with less. * Share your knowledge: by pioneering new approaches to how work is done, you will have the opportunity to share your learnings with the wider team and lead cross-functional change. * Incept and prioritise initiatives: Balance and prioritise stakeholder initiatives to always focus on business value. * Experiment and measure: Identify opportunities to experiment and test hypotheses on how we can improve customer and internal user experience, measuring the impact of your work and evidencing value return * Cross-functional leadership: you will lead a squad of Software Engineers through the definition and development of new Product initiatives to deliver the future tooling strategy. * Collaborate with Designers: To ensure we build effective solutions for both internal and external users of our Streaming apps. * Work with Product Managers: Collaborate with your Product Management colleagues to identify opportunities to support and enhance other parts of the Streaming experience. * Conduct Market Analysis: Conduct market research of off the shelf tools and competitor capabilities to identify opportunities for your remit. **Essential Qualifications, Experience \& Skills** You have a passion for consumer products and technology, and are excited by the challenge of making a positive impact on how millions of Australians consume entertainment every day. We'd particularly like to hear from you if you have: * Proven experience in Product Management or IT Business Analysis, with a focus on internal tools such as Content Management Systems or Workflow Management Systems. * Experience analysing and optimising processes and business workflows * A track record of identifying opportunities to automate operational workflows using AI tools * Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and draw meaningful conclusions to drive product improvements. * Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, to convey complex ideas and concepts. * Demonstrated ability to collaborate and influence cross-functional and cross-departmental teams effectively. * A growth mindset and a passion for technology, media, and staying up-to-date with industry trends. * Excellent project management and organizational skills, capable of managing complex product lifecycles. * Experience in a fast-paced, agile work environment. * A proactive, results-oriented mindset, with a commitment to driving innovation and customer-centric product development. **Additional Information How we work** At Nine, our flexible work options vary by role and team. Depending on the position, this may include flexible hours, hybrid work, or part-time arrangements. We welcome discussing your flexibility needs during the hiring process - just ask the Talent Acquisition team. **Our Employee Benefits Include** Nine offers a variety of benefits and perks to support you. Learn more about our full benefits offering here: https://ninecareers.com.au/benefits-and-how-we-work/ **Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion** We're committed to a safe, respectful and inclusive Nine. From day one, you'll be encouraged to bring your whole self to work and will be supported to perform at your best. We encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people, people with disabilities, and of all ages, genders, nationalities, backgrounds and cultures as we recognise the importance and value of diverse perspectives. Should you require any adjustments to the recruitment process, please advise us when you apply. **Work rights:**Please note to apply for this role you must already have the right to lawfully work and live in Australia.

title: Associate Product Manager - Digital
text: **Associate Product Manager - Technology** Fixed Term Contract (12 Months) \| Full-time \| Sydney applications preferred, open to Melbourne (Hybrid) **We are looking for...** Hopefully, you! We're seeking an experienced digital product professional to cover a 12-month maternity leave and step into a hands-on, high-ownership role at the centre of Eco Outdoor's technology function. You'll manage our website and digital platform delivery, looking after a small but distributed delivery team, and keep a wide ecosystem of systems and vendor relationships humming, all while helping shape where we go next. This role suits someone who moves naturally between the strategic and the operational. You might be writing a product brief, untangling a CMS configuration, or presenting a roadmap or product update, sometimes all in the same day. If that sounds like your kind of variety, keep reading. The Associate Product Manager's **key responsibilities** will include: * Owning the website product roadmap and quarterly delivery priorities for our Next.js/Vercel platform, built on Contentstack CMS, drawing on web analytics to inform decisions and measure performance * Defining, briefing, and managing delivery of features and enhancements from discovery through to UAT and go-live * Writing clear Jira tickets and acceptance criteria, and managing day-to-day delivery across onshore and offshore development and QA teams via a Kanban workflow, keeping work well-scoped and ensuring nothing ships without proper sign-off * Managing and maintaining our core digital platforms including Contentstack, Bynder, Algolia, and RingCentral, overseeing platform configuration, user access, licence management, and ongoing optimisation * Building and maintaining strong relationships with external partners across digital design, web development, and web analytics * Managing vendor contracts, renewals, and escalations across our core digital tools * Collaborating with internal stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Product, People \& Culture, and Technology to keep digital delivery aligned to user needs and business priorities * Line managing a small but distributed delivery team, including an engineer based in Sydney and a QA Analyst based in Indonesia, supporting their development, priorities, and workload **Requirements** **We need you to bring...** * 2 years in digital product management, digital delivery, or a closely related discipline * Solid experience with headless or composable CMS platforms * Confidence working in Agile or Kanban delivery environments, with strong Jira skills for backlog management and ticket writing * Experience managing external development partners or agencies * The ability to navigate competing priorities across cross-functional teams and keep delivery moving * Technical literacy without needing to be a developer, you understand APIs, webhooks, and front-end rendering well enough to have real conversations with engineers * An analytical mindset, you're comfortable with Google Tag Manager, GA4, search analytics, or similar tools, and you use data to ask better questions * Clear, direct communication, your briefs land, your updates are concise, and stakeholders trust your judgement * The ability to hold a broad scope across multiple simultaneous workstreams without dropping the detail * Proven experience leading or managing others, with a collaborative and supportive approach to team development * Bonus points if you bring experience with DAM platforms (Bynder or similar), Algolia and RingCentral, or have worked with offshore or distributed teams before. Please note that we require full permanent working rights for this position. **Benefits** **In return, we'll give you...** Perks, benefits and the space to grow. We offer comprehensive benefits and plenty of opportunities for career growth and development. This includes: * The opportunities you need to grow, develop and craft a career you're proud of within the global Eco Outdoor business * Paid parental leave, so we can look after you while you welcome a new human * A 50 per cent off employee discount on Eco Outdoor products * Company-sponsored shenanigans and activities to connect with your team and the broader Eco Outdoor crew, from axe-throwing escapades to lawn bowls and trivia nights * A culture of unbelievable hospitality... hello in house barista coffee machine * The opportunity to give back via our internal Social Housing and Sustainability teams. **OK, you want to know what you're getting yourself into? Let us introduce ourselves.** Established in 2001 by expert minds from the landscape design and construction industries, Eco Outdoor is an Australian-founded global brand with showrooms in Australia, New Zealand and North America. We're constantly experimenting, innovating and pushing creative boundaries, delivering the highest-quality natural stone and architectural surfaces (and outdoor furniture collections) to the international architecture market. We employ around 190 people across the globe, all of whom are dedicated to innovating, crafting and providing remarkable products and unbelievable hospitality to our clients and collaborators in the architecture and design space. We thrive on constant reinvention; regular development opportunities and a passionate culture grounded in connection and involvement. We're a tribe of collaborators, critical thinkers, problem-solvers and challenge-embracers, and we nurture our incredibly talented people to put their best foot forward every day. That starts with our core values - Be a Game Changer, Only Accept Awesome, Play as a Team, Be Curious, Get Fired up - which are deeply ingrained in our culture. Basically, we're all about fostering an innovative, industry-leading, collaborative, creative, passionate team to reach their fullest potential. That's good for humans and good for business. **If this sounds like your kind of gig...** We'd love to hear from you. If you need more information before you apply, check out our website, LinkedIn or Instagram. If you have questions those sites don't answer, flick us a line at people@ecooutdoor.com.au unless you're a recruitment agency, in which case: no, thanks. We've got this one covered.

title: Data Product Manager
text: Advoc8 is a political monitoring and intelligence platform for government relations and policy professionals. Our customers rely on Advoc8 to understand what is happening across government and access accurate, timely information about the people, institutions and issues shaping public policy. This is not a traditional software Product Manager role. It sits at the intersection of data product management, information strategy and data operations. You'll own the political information that powers Advoc8: deciding which information is most valuable to our customers, and work out how Advoc8 can source and maintain it reliably at scale. You may come from product management, knowledge or information management, research operations, data analysis or a similar role. We're less concerned with your exact title than your ability to understand a complex information landscape, form a clear view on what matters and build scalable ways to maintain it. You'll need to be curious, commercially minded and opinionated. We want someone who can look at the universe of data available to us and develop a clear point of view on what matters and what we should prioritise. **What you'll do** * Develop a deep understanding of the political data landscape and identify valuable new datasets and sources. * Own and evolve Advoc8's Data Product Roadmap, setting clear priorities for coverage and investment. * Validate data priorities with customers, Product and customer-facing teams. * Monitor data health and ensure updates are reflected quickly in Advoc8. * Design reliable, repeatable ways to source, validate and maintain data. * Oversee research and data operations, including contractors, while remaining hands-on where needed. **About you** You're a strong researcher and systems thinker who can move comfortably between strategy and detail. You'll bring: * Strong research and analytical skills, with the ability to form and communicate a clear point of view. * Good product and commercial judgement about which data creates meaningful customer value. * A systems mindset and an instinct for making processes reliable, repeatable and scalable. * High standards for accuracy and attention to detail. * Confidence engaging with customers, technical teams and senior stakeholders. * The ability to take ownership, make recommendations and work through ambiguity. * An interest in politics, government data, automation and/or data sourcing. Experience with APIs, scraping, databases, automation tools or structured datasets would be useful, but you don't need to be a software engineer.

title: Group Product Manager, Google Photos Organization and Sharing
text: At Google, we have a vision of empowerment and equitable opportunity for all Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples and commit to building reconciliation through Google's technology, platforms and people and we welcome Indigenous applicants. Please see our Reconciliation Action Plan for more information. **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * 10 years of experience in product management or a related technical role. * 5 years of experience in people management, with technical leadership. * 5 years of experience defining and delivering product roadmaps for consumer products. * Experience designing, building, and deploying applications utilizing generative AI or Large Language Model (LLM). **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree in a technology or business related field. * 7 years of experience working cross-functionally with engineering, UX/UI, sales finance, and other stakeholders. * 5 years of experience in software development or engineering. * 5 years of experience in a role preparing and delivering technical presentations to executive leadership. * Experience working in photos and video consumer product. * Demonstrated creativity and a visionary approach to defining and bringing new product ideas to life. **About the job** At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day. In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development. One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users. Google Photos is a photo sharing and storage service developed by Google. Photos is one of the most sought after products at Google and is looking for both client-side (web and mobile), with server-side (search, storage, serving) and machine intelligence (learning, computer vision) Software Engineers. We are dedicated to making Google experiences centered around the user. **Responsibilities** * Own development and secure buy-in for a product goal that identifies, defines, and supports the overall product narrative and direction, achieving an outcome that is greater than the sum of its parts. * Drive the evolution of Google Photos organization and sharing features to make them more personalized, proactive, and powerful. * Define and build the next generation of helpful user experiences by utilizing Gemini and advanced Generative AI (GenAI) capabilities. * Lead, mentor, and grow a small, high-performing team of Product Managers. * Deliver features that actively drive user love and engagement while helping users get more out of their photo libraries. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

title: Senior AI Product Manager | Hamilton Locke | Sydney
outNote: internal AI tool (vendor product) adoption, configuration, training and change management; no build team
text: An exciting opportunity for an experienced AI Product Manager to own and drive the adoption of Legora and future AI tools across Hamilton Locke, working at the intersection of technology, legal practice and firm strategy. **The role** We're looking for an experienced AI Product Manager to become the primary product owner for Legora and Hamilton Locke's growing suite of AI tools. Based in Sydney and reporting jointly to the Head of Technology and the Director of Business Performance, you will be the first point of contact for Legora and future AI tools across the firm, working closely with our practice groups to identify, configure and roll out agents, workflows and other AI capabilities that make a genuine difference to how our lawyers work. You will own the feedback loop between users and the platform, driving continuous improvement, and lead the training, communication and change management needed to embed new features successfully. Beyond Legora, you will play an active role in shaping and delivering Hamilton Locke's broader AI strategy, helping to identify, evaluate and deploy AI tools across the firm's business model and value chain. **Key Responsibilities** * Act as the primary product owner and first point of contact for Legora and future AI tools adopted across the firm. * Own the product roadmap for Legora at Hamilton Locke, prioritising new features, agents and workflows in line with practice group needs and firm strategy. * Maintain strong working relationships with Legora and other AI vendors, including escalation of issues, feature requests and commercial or licensing matters. * Partner with practice groups to identify use cases and implement agents, workflows and other AI capabilities that improve how lawyers deliver work. * Run discovery sessions with partners and lawyers to translate practice-specific workflows and pain points into configured tools and prompts. * Collect, triage and act on user feedback, maintaining a continuous improvement pipeline for tool configuration, prompts and workflows. * Design and deliver training programmes, user guides and communications for the rollout of new Legora features and other AI tools. * Build and support a network of practice group champions to embed adoption and best practice across the firm. * Track adoption, usage and satisfaction metrics, and report on outcomes to key stakeholders. * Support delivery of Hamilton Locke's broader AI strategy, working closely with the Head of Technology and Director of Business Performance. * Actively identify, evaluate and help deploy AI tools across the firm's business model and value chain, beyond legal practice tools alone (e.g. finance and HR). * Assess new AI tools and vendors, including running pilots, cost-benefit analysis and risk/compliance considerations (data privacy, confidentiality, professional obligations). * Contribute to governance frameworks and policies for the responsible use of AI within the firm. **About You** We are looking for someone: * With demonstrated experience as a Product Manager or Product Owner, ideally for AI, legal technology or other enterprise software tools, and a track record of driving adoption of new technology within a professional services or similarly regulated environment. * Who is a confident communicator and relationship-builder, comfortable engaging with partners, lawyers and business services teams to understand workflows, translate requirements into product solutions and drive change with limited direct authority. * Who is genuinely curious about legal technology and generative AI, enjoys hands-on configuration and testing of tools such as Legora, and is energised by building training materials and communications that bring users along the journey. **What You'll Bring** * Deep experience in a product management, product owner or technology enablement role, ideally involving AI, legal technology or other enterprise software within professional services, financial services or another regulated industry. * Hands-on experience configuring, administering or rolling out AI or automation tools (such as Legora, other legal AI platforms, or generative AI tools), including prompt design, workflow/agent configuration and integration considerations. * Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage credibly with partners and senior lawyers, gather requirements, manage expectations and drive adoption without direct authority. * Experience designing and delivering training, communications and change management programmes for new technology or process change. * Strong analytical skills, with the ability to define and track adoption, usage and value metrics, and to translate feedback into a clear product backlog. * An understanding of legal workflows and the practice of law is highly regarded but not essential; a genuine interest in legal services and how AI can transform them is essential. * Awareness of data privacy, confidentiality, information security and professional/ethical considerations relevant to deploying AI in a law firm environment. * A proactive, curious and pragmatic mindset, comfortable operating with ambiguity in a fast-moving, high-growth environment, and building processes and frameworks from scratch. * title: Group Product Manager - Payments
text: We've been proudly serving Australian communities since 1914 and have grown to become a top 30-listed company on the ASX with a portfolio of iconic homegrown brands. At the heart of our continued success is over 115,000 team members working across the country, all contributing to bringing our customers smiles. You'll not only get to see your work make a difference, you'll be part of a team working together to help Australians eat and live better every day. **About The Team** Our Finance team are a vital partner in every aspect of our business, providing commercial insights to drive our success and influence everything we do. With presence in every department, we analyse performance, and deliver actionable insights that shape our strategic decisions. **About The Role** Please note This is a 10 month fixed term contract. As Group Product Manager - Payments, you'll lead the strategy, roadmap and delivery of products spanning payment switching, settlement \& reconciliation, and payment terminal solutions. You'll lead three experienced Product Managers while bringing together customer needs, industry trends, commercial priorities and regulatory requirements to set clear direction. Working across Retail Payment Solutions, technology, delivery teams, customers and external partners, you'll turn that direction into meaningful outcomes at scale. You will also * Own and evolve product strategies, roadmaps and prioritised backlogs across Core products. * Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders, customers, payment schemes, technology providers and vendors. * Understand customer needs and market trends to shape compelling product requirements and value propositions. * Partner with delivery and technology teams to progress initiatives through project and Agile environments. * Support budgeting, business cases, commercial decisions, vendor management and profit and loss considerations. * Lead, coach and develop Product Managers, creating clarity, accountability and a strong team culture. **About You And Your Skills** You're an experienced payments product leader who can connect strategy with delivery, bring people together and confidently influence senior stakeholders without relying on positional authority. You combine strong customer judgement and commercial thinking with a respectful leadership style, helping experienced team members do their best work while keeping everyone focused on shared outcomes. You will have * Proven experience in a senior product management and delivery capacity, with Payments products across the end-to-end value chain. * Experience working across payments services, cards or the broader financial services industry. * Strong end-to-end product portfolio management experience, including building, managing and evolving products. * Demonstrated experience developing and owning product strategies, roadmaps and prioritised backlogs. * Strong influencing and stakeholder management skills across senior leaders, customers and external partners. * Proven customer engagement and product delivery capability within complex, cross-functional environments. * Commercial capability across budgeting, business cases, vendor management and product performance. * Strong understanding of the payments industry, key trends and emerging payment technologies. What's in it for you? * Flexible working options We know that work is only one part of your life, so we actively encourage a positive work-life balance and provide hybrid working options to help you achieve it. * Office perks Take advantage of our gym facility and fitness classes, free parking, BBQ area, mini-Coles supermarket, fooderie hub where you can sample new products before they hit the shelves, school holiday program and so much more when you come in. * Discounts Eligible team members receive 5% discount all year round on your Supermarket and Liquor online and in-store purchases. We also offer additional periods of double discount (10%) at various times throughout the year. As well as hotdeals exclusive to team members that translate into additional savings. * Reward through recognition Give and receive recognition, linked to our Coles values, through our digital recognition platform 'mythanks'. You can accumulate points to redeem in the online shop for exciting gifts and electronic gift cards from an extensive range of retailers. * Opportunities for learning and development No matter where you start within our diverse business, you'll have experiences, exposure, and education to satisfy you. Discover and explore a variety of career development programs and job-specific training. * Paid parental leave We understand how important your life outside work is and offer permanent team members paid parental leave to support you in balancing work and family. * Investment in your future Our annual team member share plan offer allows eligible team members to make regular pre-tax salary sacrifice deductions to purchase Coles Group shares. **About The Recruitment Process** We're continuing to build a gender equitable team, and a culture that is just as diverse, inclusive and welcoming as the communities we serve. We are committed to creating a workplace that is safe and respectful for our team. We encourage applications from people of all ages, cultures (including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples), abilities, sexual orientation and gender identities. We're happy to adjust our recruitment process to support candidates with disability. For further information and additional contact details visit the 'Our Recruitment Process' section of our careers site or email inclusionrecruitment@coles.com.au Job ID 197775 Employment Type Full time
